title: design-qa review decisions
description: Everything a reviewer decided in report.html, in one document: fix now / debt, dismissals with a written reason, design-backfill decisions, annotations the reviewer added on a capture (issues the pass missed), and whether tickets may be created. report.html sends it to scripts/review.mjs (saved as <report dir>/decisions.json) or embeds it in the "Copy for your agent" message inside a ```design-qa-decisions fence; scripts/apply-decisions.mjs applies it to report.json. Finding ids are renumbered on every pass, so reportGeneratedAt must equal the report's meta.generatedAt. Rules JSON Schema cannot express (no id in both triage.fixNow and triage.debt, no dismissed id also in triage, unique ids, no annotation listed twice, a BLOCKER annotation is never debt) are checked by scripts/lib/decisions.mjs.

version.description: Format version. A higher version is a newer format: update the design-qa skill.

slug.description: The report folder name (meta.ticket.key, else the kebab-cased feature).

reportGeneratedAt.description: meta.generatedAt of the report the decisions were made on.

tickets.description: The reviewer authorised creating tickets for the debt items (default false).

triage.description: Every triageable finding that is not dismissed in this document, split into fix now (in the order to fix) and debt. Absent: the triage is left as it is.

dismissals.description: Dismissals not yet recorded in report.json.

backfill.description: Design-backfill decisions not yet recorded in report.json.

reason.description: Required (non-empty) for not-needed; an optional note for build.

annotations.description: Issues the reviewer marked on a state's capture because the pass missed them, in the order they were added. scripts/apply-decisions.mjs records each in <report dir>/annotations.json (ids AN-001, AN-002 …; never twice: the same state, side, box and note is the same annotation); the agent investigates and files each in findings.json, and the rebuilt report shows it as a finding. Omitted when there are none.

state.description: A state of the report (stateMatrix[].state), e.g. "with-data" or "cart/empty".

side.description: The image the reviewer marked: the app capture or the design. That state must have it.

box.description: The box the reviewer drew, in that image's pixels: whole numbers, starting inside the image, at least 8×8.

note.description: The reviewer's description of the issue (at most 2000 characters once trimmed).

decision.description: Fix now or later. A BLOCKER is always fix-now.
